release_notes: v1.2.4: Adds serialized live VAD-chunk transcription for Parakeet TDT v2/v3. Every contiguous original PCM range is queued and decoded in order; Stop drains outstanding work and transcript polishing runs once after assembly. Unified, completed-file and History paths remain unchanged. ARM64-only; updates remain manual. Accuracy, latency and power use have not been validated on-device.
